jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities

Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. Feed field learnings back to AWS service teams, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron. Identify opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer engagement.

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Team

The Custom Model and Optimization team, part of the Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with enterprises, AI-native startups, and foundation model providers to build, customize, and optimize generative AI models at scale. Our work spans domain foundation models, post-training of open-weight models, and moving training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. As embedded engineers within the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering motion, we bring deep model and optimization expertise to customers' most strategic AI workloads, and we turn what we learn into tooling and patterns that scale across AWS.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Experience programming with at least one software programming language
Hands-on experience with generative AI technology, such as LLMs, vision-language models, or speech models

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with large-scale distributed training of LLMs on multi-node accelerator clusters, using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, TorchTitan, Megatron-LM/Megatron Core, NeMo, DeepSpeed, or NeuronX Distributed
Experience with LLM post-training, including SFT, DPO, RLHF, and RL with verifiable rewards or multi-turn agentic RL, using frameworks such as Miles, slime, verl, NeMo-RL, OpenRLHF, SkyRL, or TRL
Experience optimizing model training or inference for latency, throughput, or cost, using serving engines such as SGLang, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM, on AWS Trainium or Inferentia (Neuron SDK), on AWS services such as SageMaker AI, SageMaker HyperPod, or EKS, or by writing custom kernels (CUDA, Triton, NKI)
Experience deploying and operating ML models in customer production environments, working with teams that build and scale end-to-end production systems

jobs.description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

This job will design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex problems. Develop and optimize machine learning models for various applications.

Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models.

3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and tools for data processing and model deployment.
Several years of experience in designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning models.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

We’re searching for a Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

In this role you will

Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

Required Qualifications

Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

Desirable Qualifications

ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Calibration & Optimization
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Calibration is fundamental to the accuracy, stability and productivity of semiconductor inspection and metrology systems. KLA is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to rethink how electron-optical systems are calibrated and recalibrated—using machine learning, mathematical and statistical modeling, physics-informed AI and large-scale engineering data. You will develop next-generation calibration solutions that reduce calibration time, improve accuracy and repeatability, compensate for drift, strengthen tool-to-tool matching, and enable more intelligent diagnostics and recovery. This role combines advanced modeling with real experimental systems: you will develop algorithms, validate them against hardware data and work with engineering teams to integrate successful solutions into products. The underlying mission and scope come directly from the team’s need to modernize calibration, diagnostics and optimization across electron sources, electron-optical columns, steering systems, detectors, alignment, focus, high-voltage, and vacuum-related performance.

What You Will Do

Redesign calibration and recalibration workflows to improve speed, accuracy, repeatability, robustness, and system productivity.
Develop and validate calibration algorithms for electron sources, electron-optical columns, deflectors and beam-steering systems, detectors, alignment and focus functions, and performance compensation associated with high-voltage and vacuum behavior.
Apply machine learning, statistical modeling and physics-informed AI to predict calibration outcomes, model system behavior, and improve calibration decisions.
Build methods to detect drift, anomalies and performance excursions using engineering, operational and fleet-level data.
Optimize calibration sequences to reduce time, eliminate unnecessary steps, and balance accuracy, throughput, and system risk.
Develop adaptive and self-correcting approaches that respond to changing system conditions and support more autonomous calibration behavior.
Create intelligent diagnostic and recovery methods that accelerate root-cause identification and restore system performance after calibration or hardware excursions.
Build and combine physics-based and data-driven models, including correlation models, response models, sensitivity studies, uncertainty estimates and error-propagation analyses.
Analyze large, heterogeneous engineering datasets to identify performance patterns, tool-to-tool differences, failure modes, and opportunities for improvement.
Design and execute experiments to evaluate calibration repeatability, reproducibility, robustness, and generalization across operating conditions.
Correlate model predictions with experimental measurements and use discrepancies to refine models, algorithms, and calibration strategies.
Partner with electron optics, systems, software, algorithm, manufacturing, and service teams to translate system requirements into deployable calibration and monitoring solutions.
Support the full path from concept through algorithm implementation, experimental validation, product qualification, and production deployment.
Continuously evaluate advances in scientific machine learning, optimization, anomaly detection, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, and intelligent control.

Required Qualifications

M.S. or Ph.D. in Physics, Applied Physics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Optical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Three or more years of relevant industrial or applied research experience. Relevant doctoral or postdoctoral work may qualify when it demonstrates substantial ownership of applied modeling, algorithm development, experimentation or engineering-data analysis.
Demonstrated experience developing and validating machine-learning, statistical or mathematical models for complex physical, scientific or engineering problems.
Strong foundation in several of the following:

Numerical optimization
Probability and statistics
Linear algebra and numerical methods
Regression, estimation, or system identification
Time-series or multivariate analysis
Sensitivity analysis, uncertainty quantification, or error propagation
Proficiency in Python and practical experience with a modern ML or scientific-computing framework such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn, SciPy or a comparable environment.
Experience working with substantial engineering, experimental, simulation, sensor, telemetry, or operational datasets.
Evidence of personally developing or materially improving an algorithm, model, or optimization method—not solely applying an off-the-shelf model.
Experience designing experiments, evaluating model performance, and correlating analytical or model predictions with measured results.
Ability to independently frame ambiguous technical problems, test hypotheses, evaluate tradeoffs and communicate conclusions to cross-functional engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with calibration, system identification, controls, diagnostics, drift compensation, predictive maintenance or condition monitoring.
Familiarity with electron-optical systems, SEM, charged-particle optics, semiconductor inspection or metrology equipment.
Experience with advanced scientific instruments, imaging systems, robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace systems, medical imaging, industrial equipment or other sensor-rich physical platforms.
Experience with fleet data, machine telemetry, high-dimensional time-series data or distributed engineering-data environments.
Familiarity with physics-informed neural networks, neural operators, surrogate models, differentiable simulation, inverse problems or hybrid physics/data models.
Experience with design of experiments, statistical process control, robust optimization, Bayesian methods or uncertainty-aware modeling.
Experience accelerating scientific workloads with GPUs, HPC or parallel computing.
Experience translating Python or research prototypes into production software; C++ experience is helpful but not required.
Experience contributing algorithms to a released product or operational engineering workflow.

Minimum Qualifications

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Seekr is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise AI. As a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the platforms that enable large-scale training, serving, evaluation, and deployment of foundation models and autonomous AI agents.

You will work across distributed systems, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, high-performance inference, and enterprise AI platforms to build secure, scalable, and highly reliable systems capable of serving workloads ranging from edge AI deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, AI platform engineering, and production software development. You will collaborate with research scientists, software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure engineers to define the architecture and technical direction of Seekr’s AI platform.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production AI infrastructure supporting model training, fine-tuning, inference, evaluation, and agentic AI workloads.
Design and operate scalable Kubernetes-based infrastructure supporting GPU-accelerated workloads across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and edge environments.
Architect and optimize high-performance inference platforms capable of serving models ranging from resource-constrained edge deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models, with a focus on latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Build and maintain distributed systems that enable reliable scheduling, orchestration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI workloads.
Develop enterprise platforms supporting autonomous and multi-agent AI systems, including secure tool execution, orchestration, memory, evaluation, governance, and observability.
Design, implement, and automate AI infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering practices.
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI infrastructure technologies, model serving frameworks, hardware accelerators, and cloud-native platforms to improve platform performance, scalability, and reliability.
Collaborate with engineering, research, product, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready AI platforms.
Lead technical design discussions, perform architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and establish engineering standards and best practices across the AI Infrastructure organization.
Participate in production support activities, including troubleshooting complex distributed systems, performance tuning, incident response, and continuous operational improvement.

Skills and Qualifications

5–8 years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale platform services
Strong production ML infra experience, executes complex work independently, owns significant components
4 year or higher degree or additional relevant experience, in addition to years of work experience
Demonstrated success designing and operating production Kubernetes environments supporting cloud-native applications and distributed services.
Strong software engineering skills using Python and one or more modern programming languages such as Go, Rust, or C++.
Proven ability to design, build, and operate production AI or machine learning infrastructure.
Expertise developing and optimizing large-scale AI inference platforms, including GPU utilization, distributed inference, batching, caching, quantization, and accelerator performance.
Familiarity with modern AI serving technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of distributed computing, networking, storage systems, cloud-native architectures, and infrastructure automation using technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
Experience developing enterprise AI platforms, autonomous agents, or multi-agent systems, including orchestration, tool execution, governance, observability, and evaluation.
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed messaging systems, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Demonstrated technical leadership, including driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading complex technical initiatives across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, profile, and optimize AI systems for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost across distributed compute environments.

This range reflects Seekr’s good faith estimate of what it expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Seekr is a leader in explainable and trustworthy artificial intelligence designed to power mission-critical decisions in enterprises, government, and regulated industries. Available across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments, SeekrFlow reduces bias, strengthens data integrity, and simplifies model oversight so organizations can rely on trusted AI decisions in high-stakes settings that impact society’s most sensitive and vital systems. Trusted by leading enterprises and government agencies, we partner with defense, finance, telecom, and critical infrastructure leaders to enable AI solutions that drive real-world results with unmatched transparency and control. jobs.title: Software Architect, AI Systems and Platform
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Software Architect Opportunity
The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.
We are hiring two hands-on architects. One will lead agent execution, harnesses and evaluations. The other will lead backend services, integrations, data and platform reliability. You will write critical code, resolve cross-team decisions and work with engineers through production rollout.
About You
Hands-on builder:
You still write production code and test important decisions through implementation.
Practical architect:
You choose a small, clear design and make it easy to extend when the product grows.
Trusted partner:
You earn confidence through useful code, clear feedback and customer understanding.
What you will be doing
Define and implement shared contracts for tasks, events, permissions, approvals, evidence and usage.
Set clear boundaries between model reasoning, agent harnesses, durable workflows and services that enforce authorization.
Select a harness through representative identity tasks, failure tests and operational evidence. Keep model providers and harness components replaceable.
Design integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, including data boundaries, latency, cost, version changes and measured release quality.
Build reference services for tenant isolation, scoped tool execution, idempotency, long approval waits and verified results.
Define the transactional and analytics data architecture. Keep PostgreSQL application state separate from the planned ClickHouse or BigQuery analytics layer.
Connect Product, Applied AI and Platform engineers through clear ownership and practical APIs. Resolve dependencies that slow delivery.
Write critical implementations, review recovery and security, and guide technical leads through production rollout and customer expansion.

What you will bring to the role
A record of leading architecture and delivery across multiple engineering teams, with recent production code you personally implemented.
Deep knowledge of distributed services, API design, data consistency, cloud security and production operations.
Experience making systems simpler while improving reliability, security or delivery speed.
The ability to explain design tradeoffs, guide senior engineers and remain accountable through implementation.
Depth in at least one of the two role areas below, plus the ability to work across the full product.

Role focus
AI systems architect:
Build and evaluate agent harnesses, context management, model integrations and quality controls. Relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a comparable custom runtime.
Platform architect:
Lead backend, connector, security, data and workflow architecture. Bring deep production systems experience and practical knowledge of integrating model-driven workflows.
Our stack
Python FastAPI, React and TypeScript, AWS Amplify, Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge and API Gateway. Storage uses RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector and S3. Security and operations include KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail.
We are adding OpenAI and Anthropic model API integrations. An agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery are planned. You will help choose and implement them.
And extra credit for
Enterprise identity, security products, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or complex customer integrations.
ClickHouse, BigQuery, agent evaluations, post-training systems or open-source infrastructure.
Building a new product within a larger enterprise and keeping technical decisions reversible.

10+

Perform EDA to identify trends and generate deep-level insights

Data Analysis & SQL — Strong EDA skills with advanced SQL proficiency
Setting Goals & Success Metrics — Ability to collaborate with stakeholders on defining OKRs and measuring progress
10+ years of quantitative/analytical experience — Using scripting languages (Python), statistical tools, and data querying at scale

Storytelling Through Data — Communicating insights to technical and non-technical audiences

Job Summary

Our team is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Scientist to serve as Key Personnel for a critical U.S. Navy technical management support contract. You will lead the contractor team's technical development and implementation of advanced analytics applications. Your role will transform raw data into actionable insights to support major defense acquisition programs and weapon systems.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics: Lead the application of data mining, data modeling, natural language processing (NLP), and machine learning to extract and analyze information from large structured and unstructured datasets.
Technical Leadership: Oversee the application of data-oriented programming languages and visualization software. Guide the visualization, interpretation, and reporting of data findings to ensure clear communication of insights to Government stakeholders.
Automation & Tooling: Automate organizational work through scripts for data processing and analytics. Develop and apply algorithms and machine learning methods.
Mentorship: Support and guide junior staff and collaborate with senior team members to enhance project outcomes.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field (Master's degree preferred).
Experience: No specific minimum years required, but must demonstrate the ability to lead advanced analytics projects. Must meet the qualification requirements for the Data Scientist Advanced level (CWF Model 423).
Technical Skills: Expertise in data mining, machine learning, and data visualization. Proficiency in data-oriented programming languages.
Security: Must possess or be able to obtain a Secret DoD Clearance.

jobs.title: GenAI Developer
jobs.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced GenAI Developer
to build and maintain a production-grade healthcare conversational AI platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, FastAPI, Google ADK 2.0, multi-agent orchestration, and LLM integration, along with hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services.
The role involves developing scalable backend APIs, implementing RAG pipelines, building secure AI-powered healthcare workflows, and ensuring reliable, safe, and compliant conversational experiences.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain backend APIs using Python 3.12+ and FastAPI.
Build and manage multi-agent AI workflows using Google ADK 2.0.
Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
Implement RAG, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and AI guardrails.

Integrate Azure services, including Cosmos DB, Key Vault, App Configuration, Event Hubs, and Application Insights.
Implement secure API authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth, and industry best practices.
Protect sensitive healthcare data and follow applicable privacy and security requirements.

Monitor production applications, troubleshoot issues, improve observability, and participate in incident response.
Collaborate with Agile teams on architecture, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

7+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with Python 3.12+ and FastAPI or similar asynchronous frameworks.
Production experience with Google ADK 2.0
for multi-agent orchestration and structured LLM outputs.

Practical experience with Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Key Vault, and App Configuration.
Experience with event-driven architecture and workflow orchestration.
Strong understanding of JWT, OAuth, API security, and secure data handling.
Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and production deployments.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and ownership skills.

Good-to-Have Skills
Healthcare domain experience, including HIPAA, HL7/FHIR, or Epic integrations.
Experience with PydanticAI and schema-based output validation.

jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Seekr is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise AI. As a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the platforms that enable large-scale training, serving, evaluation, and deployment of foundation models and autonomous AI agents.

You will work across distributed systems, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, high-performance inference, and enterprise AI platforms to build secure, scalable, and highly reliable systems capable of serving workloads ranging from edge AI deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, AI platform engineering, and production software development. You will collaborate with research scientists, software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure engineers to define the architecture and technical direction of Seekr’s AI platform.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production AI infrastructure supporting model training, fine-tuning, inference, evaluation, and agentic AI workloads.
Design and operate scalable Kubernetes-based infrastructure supporting GPU-accelerated workloads across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and edge environments.
Architect and optimize high-performance inference platforms capable of serving models ranging from resource-constrained edge deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models, with a focus on latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Build and maintain distributed systems that enable reliable scheduling, orchestration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI workloads.
Develop enterprise platforms supporting autonomous and multi-agent AI systems, including secure tool execution, orchestration, memory, evaluation, governance, and observability.
Design, implement, and automate AI infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering practices.
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI infrastructure technologies, model serving frameworks, hardware accelerators, and cloud-native platforms to improve platform performance, scalability, and reliability.
Collaborate with engineering, research, product, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready AI platforms.
Lead technical design discussions, perform architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and establish engineering standards and best practices across the AI Infrastructure organization.
Participate in production support activities, including troubleshooting complex distributed systems, performance tuning, incident response, and continuous operational improvement.

Skills and Qualifications

5–8 years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale platform services
Strong production ML infra experience, executes complex work independently, owns significant components
4 year or higher degree or additional relevant experience, in addition to years of work experience
Demonstrated success designing and operating production Kubernetes environments supporting cloud-native applications and distributed services.
Strong software engineering skills using Python and one or more modern programming languages such as Go, Rust, or C++.
Proven ability to design, build, and operate production AI or machine learning infrastructure.
Expertise developing and optimizing large-scale AI inference platforms, including GPU utilization, distributed inference, batching, caching, quantization, and accelerator performance.
Familiarity with modern AI serving technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of distributed computing, networking, storage systems, cloud-native architectures, and infrastructure automation using technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
Experience developing enterprise AI platforms, autonomous agents, or multi-agent systems, including orchestration, tool execution, governance, observability, and evaluation.
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed messaging systems, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Demonstrated technical leadership, including driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading complex technical initiatives across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, profile, and optimize AI systems for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost across distributed compute environments.

This range reflects Seekr’s good faith estimate of what it expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Placement within the range depends on a number of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, applicable labor categories under Seekr’s federal government contracts, relevant prior work experience, specific skills, education, and certifications. This role may also be eligible for annual bonus, equity, other other incentive compensation.

jobs.description:
United Risk is a global property and casualty insurance underwriting and distribution platform. It is independently owned and operated by its practice partners and affiliated with Applied Underwriters. Our practices cover specialty casualty and property, surety, financial lines, aviation, crisis and political risk, marine, fine art and more. Each one is led by underwriters who run their specialty with real autonomy.

Our AI team builds the tools that make those underwriters quicker and smarter. That includes submission ingestion, underwriting workbenches, risk analysis, and automation across the back and middle office. Our focus is to deliver tailored solutions to improve efficiency, while also maintaining our standards to security and compliance.

The Role:

You'll be one of a small group of AI Engineers. You'll work directly with underwriters and operations staff. You'll adapt the products we already run to their needs, and build new ones where nothing fits.

This role leans toward data science: turning our submission, policy and loss data into insight underwriters can act on. Everyone on the team also builds applications and works on infrastructure. Three senior AI engineers review your work and teach you along the way.

Requirements:

A bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or a related field
0–4 years of experience, including internships and co-ops
Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with messy real-world data
A grounding in statistics
Work you built yourself and can show us. For this role, that means one or more of:
A structured-extraction or document-processing project
A RAG or document Q&A system
An evaluation or testing setup for model or LLM output
A data analysis or modeling project on a real dataset

Curiosity about how the business runs, and the patience to learn insurance from the people who know it
Clear communication with non-technical colleagues

Our Benefits Include:

100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees
401(k) plan with 100% immediate vesting and a 4% company match
Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays.
Life, disability, critical illness and accident insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Pre-tax Flexible Spending Accounts for health, dependent care, and commuter-related expenses
Tuition reimbursement
Fitness reimbursement and various additional quality-of-life benefits

How To Apply

Apply through this posting with your résumé and a link to your GitHub, a deployed app or a portfolio. We review portfolios first. If you're shortlisted, you'll walk one of our senior engineers through a project you built and the choices you made.

United Risk is independently owned and operated by its practice partners and is affiliated with Applied Underwriters through its common and powerful brand identity.

jobs.title: Generative AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

Job Title: Generative AI Engineer (GenAI / LLM)

Experience: 5+ Years (Recommended; adjust based on the requirement)
Employment Type: Contract / Full-Time (As Applicable)

Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern AI engineering frameworks. The ideal candidate will have strong Python development experience, hands-on expertise in LLM integration, prompt engineering, vector databases, and scalable AI application development. The successful candidate will collaborate with data science, software engineering, cloud, and product teams to build secure, reliable, and production-ready generative AI solutions that address real-world business requirements.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to retrieve, process, and generate contextually relevant responses from enterprise data.
Integrate commercial and open-source LLMs through APIs and model-serving frameworks.
Develop prompt templates, system instructions, few-shot examples, and structured output strategies to improve model accuracy and consistency.
Build document ingestion and processing pipelines, including text extraction, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, indexing, and retrieval.
Implement semantic search and hybrid retrieval using vector databases and search technologies.
Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows to support multi-step reasoning and task execution where appropriate.
Build backend services and APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
Integrate GenAI applications with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and existing business applications.
Evaluate model responses for relevance, factual accuracy, groundedness, latency, and cost.
Implement safeguards to reduce hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and inappropriate model outputs.
Optimize LLM performance through prompt optimization, caching, model selection, retrieval tuning, and other appropriate techniques.
Collaborate with cloud and platform engineering teams to deploy and operate AI applications in scalable environments.
Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, evaluation pipelines, and production troubleshooting for AI systems.
Follow software engineering best practices, including version control, automated testing, code reviews, documentation, and CI/CD.
Participate in technical design discussions and translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.

Qualifications

Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Required Skills

Required Technical Skills
Generative AI and LLMs
Strong understanding of Generative AI concepts, transformer architectures, and Large Language Models.
Hands-on experience integrating LLMs such as GPT-family models, Claude, Llama, or other suitable models.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and model response evaluation.
Understanding of tokenization, context windows, embeddings, temperature, and model inference parameters.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
Knowledge of document parsing, chunking strategies, embedding models, retrieval, reranking, and context construction.
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Chroma, or FAISS.
Understanding of semantic search, metadata filtering, hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.
Programming and Application Development
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience developing REST APIs and backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent frameworks.
Familiarity with asynchronous programming, data processing, exception handling, testing, and debugging.
Experience integrating external APIs, databases, and enterprise application services.
AI Frameworks and Libraries
Experience with one or more frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent GenAI development libraries.
Familiarity with embedding models, model orchestration, tool calling, and AI workflow development.
Knowledge of agent frameworks and multi-step AI workflows is an advantage.
Data and Databases
Experience working with SQL and structured or unstructured data.
Understanding of document processing, data preparation, metadata management, and indexing.
Experience with relational databases and at least one vector database or search platform.
Cloud, Deployment, and Operations
Experience deploying applications in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and production deployment practices.
Understanding of scalability, availability, security, latency, and cost optimization for AI applications.
Knowledge of MLOps or LLMOps practices is preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to convert business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Effective collaboration with engineering, data, security, and product teams.
Strong communication, documentation, and technical decision-making skills.
Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, data, retrieval, and model layers.

Preferred Skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience building production-grade GenAI applications used by business teams or external customers.
Familiarity with fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, or model adaptation.
Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLMs and RAG systems.
Understanding of guardrails, responsible AI, model governance, and data privacy.
Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, and distributed application architectures.
Knowledge of observability tools and automated quality testing for AI workflows.
Experience in enterprise environments involving sensitive or regulated data.

Pay range and compensation package

Expected Outcomes

Deliver reliable and maintainable GenAI applications aligned with business requirements.
Improve response quality through effective retrieval, prompt design, and evaluation.
Build secure and scalable AI services suitable for production workloads.
Reduce unnecessary model calls and optimize application latency and operating costs.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Software Engineer Opportunity
The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.
You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.
About You
Reliable builder:
You design for failure and prove that recovery works.
Hands-on engineer:
You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.
Strong owner:
You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.
What you will be doing
Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications.
Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries.
Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials.
Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls.
Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery.
Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes.
Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production.
Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect.

What you will bring to the role
Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language.
Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases.
Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures.
Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.
Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems.

Scope by level
Senior:
Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.
Staff:
Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.
Principal:
Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services.
Our stack
Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.
OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open.
And extra credit for
ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering.
Multi-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development.
Deploying agent frameworks, including Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, Strands Agents, Deep Agents or LangGraph. Prior identity experience is optional.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Triage (NYC)
jobs.description:
Why AssemblyAI
AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.
We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.
If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.
We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!
About the role:
AssemblyAI is growing quickly, and we're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer for our Triage team. You'll own a book of customer accounts up to $50K a year. You'll solve their technical problems directly and build and run the agents that handle our first line of customer contact. Most of your work happens in Slack, with customers and with our Engineering and Research teams.

This role is hybrid. You'll need to live within commuting distance of our NYC office.
What You’ll Do:
Own your accounts.

Be the technical owner for customers spending up to $50K a year. Diagnose integration issues, unblock them fast, and spot accounts that are ready to grow. Route commercial and pricing conversations to our Portfolio team.
Build and manage agents.

We run internal agents for customer support and operations, including our customer-facing chat agent, which you'll help bring back online. You'll iterate on these agents, build new ones, and own their quality.
Turn escalations into fixes.

When our chat agent can't resolve something, it escalates to you. Solve the customer's problem, then fix the agent so it handles that case next time.
Close the loop with Engineering and Research.

File bugs and feature requests with enough evidence to act on, and turn what customers tell you into product changes.
Improve our docs and SDKs.

Fix what's confusing customers at the source.

What You’ll Need:
2+ years in a technical, customer-facing role (solutions engineering, technical support, developer relations, or software development). We'll consider 1 year for someone with a strong solutions background.
Proficiency in at least one programming language. Python preferred; other languages considered.
Daily use of coding agents like Claude Code or Codex, with real projects shipped using them. You manage context across long tasks and check agent output before it reaches a customer.
Experience with REST APIs, and the ability to read and debug customer code
Strong written communication. Most of this job happens in Slack.
Ability to hear a customer use case and map it to what our API can do

Nice to Have:
You've built an agent or automation that other people rely on
SQL
Experience with speech, audio, or voice AI products

Where this role leads:
Triage is where you learn our product, our customers, and how we build with agents. Engineers who do well here move into larger books on our Portfolio and Strategic teams. Your manager will work with you on what that path looks like and the timeline.
Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.
Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.
The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States
. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.
Salary range: $115,000 - $135,000 

Our total compensation package includes competitive  equity grants
, 100% employer-paid benefits, and working alongside the team in our New York City office. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US-based full time team members.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect (US Government) [623]
jobs.description:
About Elucida Labs

Elucida Labs is building the autonomous AI Scientist for Semiconductor Manufacturing
.
Advanced wafer fabrication, spanning thin-film deposition (ALD, CVD, PVD), plasma etch (RIE, ALE), CMP, and advanced packaging, is bottlenecked by brutal multi-month empirical trial-and-error cycles. We build intelligent software that eliminates months of guesswork and trial-and-error in semiconductor manufacturing.

Backed by top founders and mentors (Stanford StartX F26), we work with semiconductor equipment OEMs, microelectronics research institutes, and Fabs. As a Founding Staff AI Engineer, you will own the technical architecture from core scientific models to live customer deployments.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional, high-agency Founding Staff AI Engineer
who thrives at the intersection of deep scientific modeling, autonomous agentic architectures, and rapid production full-stack engineering.

We operate with extreme engineering leverage: our team heavily uses agentic developer tooling, including Claude Code, Cursor, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), to ship robust, production-grade systems at 10x startup velocity. You will bridge physical process models and large-scale autonomous LLM agents, write full-stack code, and deploy directly into customer evaluations and pilots.

Key Responsibilities

1. Physics AI & Scientific Machine Learning

Design and implement Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), neural operators (FNOs, DeepONets), and surrogate models to simulate plasma dynamics, chemical kinetics, thermal budgets, and material interfaces.
Build active learning and Bayesian optimization pipelines to recommend optimal recipe parameters (gas flow, RF power, pressure, temperature profiles) under sparse, high-cost experimental constraints.
Ingest and featurize complex, multimodal semiconductor fab telemetry: optical emission spectroscopy (OES), residual gas analysis (RGA), in-situ metrology, and wafer-level morphology data.

2. Agentic AI & Autonomous Scientific Workflows

Develop robust, deterministic multi-agent systems that autonomously decompose complex engineering goals into actionable experimental design, data querying, and simulation workflows.
Build tool-use capabilities and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers allowing agents to execute scientific code, run numerical solvers, and synthesize technical papers/patents.
Implement structured reasoning, guardrails, state-machine verifiers, and memory stores to ensure agent outputs meet rigorous physical plausibility and safety criteria.

3. Full-Stack Engineering & AI-Augmented Velocity

Architect, build, and maintain our end-to-end software platform: high-performance backend microservices (Python/FastAPI/AsyncIO), database layers, and intuitive engineering dashboards (TypeScript/React/Next.js).
Leverage agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code CLI and modern agent environments) to autonomously write test suites, refactor codebases, automate CI/CD tasks, and maximize raw development output.
Construct robust ETL pipelines and secure data connectors capable of ingesting high-frequency equipment time-series and legacy SECS/GEM or flat-file fab logs.

4. Customer Delivery & Pilot Execution

Own technical deployment and integration during pilot programs with equipment OEMs and cleanroom customer sites.
Work shoulder-to-shoulder with customer process engineers, CTOs, and fab managers to translate complex domain challenges into working product capabilities.
Deploy air-gapped or hybrid on-prem/VPC customer instances ensuring enterprise-grade data isolation, encryption, and zero-data-leakage compliance.

Qualifications

Scientific & Applied ML Background:
Proven experience building and deploying scientific ML models, PINNs, surrogate models, or complex physical simulation workflows (fluids, plasma, materials, or chemical engineering domains).
Agentic & LLM Expertise:
Hands-on experience building production-grade agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or bespoke state machines), advanced tool-calling, evaluation frameworks, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
AI-First Developer Leverage:
Daily fluency with agentic coding environments (especially Claude Code, Cursor, or custom terminal agents) and protocols like MCP to accelerate prototyping, multi-file refactors, and test coverage.
Full-Stack Competence:
Proficiency with modern backend and frontend stacks (Python/FastAPI, TypeScript/React/Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind, GraphQL/REST).
Data & Systems Infrastructure:
Experience with relational and time-series databases (PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), vector databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Startup Velocity & Customer Focus:
Ability to navigate ambiguity, ship working code daily, iterate directly based on customer feedback, and take extreme end-to-end ownership.
U.S. Person
: Due to US export control regulations, this position strictly requires the applicant to be a 'U.S. Person' (a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident, or approved Asylee/Refugee).

Bonus Points

·       Advanced Degree:
Ph.D. from a Tier-1 university (e.g., Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, Caltech, UIUC, or top international equivalent) in Computer Science, Applied Physics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical disciplines.
·       Core Compute/Systems:
Experience with high-performance computing and physics engines (C++).
·       AI & Physics Modeling:
Familiarity with physics-informed machine learning and AI frameworks (NVIDIA Modulus, NVIDIA NeMo, PyTorch).
·       Semiconductor Domain Knowledge:
Prior background or academic research in semiconductor processing, nanotechnology, thin films (ALD, CVD, Etch, CMP), or electronic materials.
·       Fab Protocols & Tool Interfacing:
Experience interfacing with hardware control systems, industrial IoT, or fab communication protocols (SECS/GEM, EDA/Interface A).
·       Tooling & Protocol Extensions:
Experience authoring custom MCP servers or building integrations for agentic coding tools.
·       Early-Stage Experience:
Previous experience as a founder, founding engineer, or early-stage engineer in a venture-backed deep-tech or enterprise AI startup.

Why Join Elucida Labs?

Pivotal Ownership:
Ground-floor equity and outsized influence in setting company architecture, culture, and technical vision.
Massive Industrial Impact:
Directly accelerate the physical limits of semiconductor fabrication, advanced packaging, and microelectronics manufacturing.
World-Class Ecosystem:
Tight access to top-tier semiconductor industry executives, fab leaders, and the Stanford StartX network.

We are seeking a highly motivated Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work directly with enterprise customers, bridging the gap between product engineering, AI, data platforms, and business outcomes. This role combines technical consulting, solution architecture, software development, and stakeholder management to deliver production-grade AI, data, and automation solutions in complex enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with experience deploying scalable AI and data platforms, integrating enterprise systems, and translating customer requirements into robust technical solutions. You will work closely with customers, product teams, architects, and leadership to accelerate adoption, drive innovation, and maximize business value.

Partner directly with customers to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

jobs.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Job Family Definition:

Develops and programs integrated software algorithms to structure, analyze and leverage structured and unstructured data in product and systems applications. Can work with large scale computing frameworks, data analysis systems, and modeling environments.

Uses machine learning and statistical modeling techniques to improve product/system performance, data management, quality, and accuracy. Formulates descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive insights/algorithms and translates technical specifications into code. Applies, optimizes and scales deep learning technologies and algorithms to give computers the capability to visualize, learn and respond to complex situations. Documents procedures for installation and maintenance, completes programming, performs testing and debugging, defines and monitors performance metrics.

Contributes to the success of HPE by translating customer requirements and industry trends into AI/ML products, solutions, and systems improvement projects.

Management Level Definition

Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.

Responsibilities

Conducts research and stays up to date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning technologies, frameworks, and algorithms. Explore and experiment with cutting-edge techniques to solve complex problems and improve existing models.
Collaborates with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and design AI and machine learning solutions. Determine the appropriate algorithms, models, and frameworks to use and architect the overall system to ensure scalability, efficiency, and robustness.
Develops, implements, and optimizes machine learning models and algorithms. This includes data pre-processing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and training on large datasets. Continuously monitor and improve model performance and accuracy.
Deploys machine learning models into production environments, considering scalability, performance, and security considerations.
Integrate models with existing software systems and infrastructure, ensuring smooth operation and interoperability.
Monitors the performance of deployed models, collects relevant metrics, and analyzes data to identify areas for improvement. Based on insights gained from monitoring and analysis, fine-tune models, optimize algorithms, and enhance system performance.
Organizes and leads comprehensive design review sessions, driving discussions to align with project requirements and best practices. Mentor and provide feedback to junior and mid-level team members.
Works collaboratively with the engineering manager and team lead to set design and implementation standards, ensuring continuous improvement and alignment with project goals.
Regularly leads meetings, fostering a collaborative and productive team environment.
Has experience in providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
Address and resolve challenges proactively.
Develops and delivers strategic presentations and reports to senior stakeholders, demonstrating a deep understanding of technical and business aspects. Provide insights and recommendations.
Applies and leverages data mining, data modeling, natural language processing, and machine learning to extract and analyze information from datasets.

Education And Experience Required

Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or closely related quantitative discipline.
Typically, 7-10 years’ experience.

Knowledge And Skills

Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, such as linear regression, decision trees, support vector machines, random forests, deep learning models (e.g., neural networks), and reinforcement learning. Proficient in model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluating model performance using appropriate metrics.
A strong foundation in mathematics and statistics. In-depth knowledge of linear algebra, calculus, probability theory, and statistical concepts. Understanding and developing complex machine learning models and algorithms.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Java is expected. Experience developing production-level code and familiarity with software engineering best practices, version control systems (e.g., Git), and software development methodologies are also required. Additionally, knowledge of libraries and frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, sci-kit, and Keras is a plus.
Advanced knowledge and experience in deep learning. Understanding advanced neural network architectures (e.g., convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, transformers) and advanced techniques such as transfer learning, generative models, and optimization algorithms for deep learning.
Actively staying updated with the latest AI and machine learning research advancements. Experience conducting research, exploring emerging technologies, and identifying opportunities to apply state-of-the-art techniques to solve complex problems.
Must have excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders effectively. Possess strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities to guide projects, make strategic decisions, and solve complex technical challenges.
Strong programming skills, with expertise in Python, R, or Java, are necessary. Experience with popular machine learning frameworks and libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or sci-kit is essential.
A deep understanding of statistical modeling, data mining, and data visualization is highly preferred.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
