jobs.description:
TL;DR
- We’re looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You’ll build and lead an exceptional FDE team, while working alongside our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. You’ll remain deeply hands-on — working directly with our most ambitious customers, writing production code, and building alongside your team.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What makes this role special?

You will:

Build and lead the FDE team in your location
Join a small group of FDE leaders defining how the function operates and scales globally
Stay deeply hands-on — personally building and shipping alongside your team
Partner with customers building never-seen-before AI systems
Set a high technical bar across architecture, engineering, and execution
Turn patterns from real deployments into core product and platform improvements
Influence our product direction, technical roadmap, and how FDE works at Lovable

If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself — this is that role.

What We’re Looking For

12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering
Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams
A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown
Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals across modern frontend and backend development
Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end
Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users
Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior customer stakeholders
High agency and comfort operating in high-ambiguity, high-velocity environments

Bonus if you’ve:

Built a team or technical function from zero
Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production
Led zero-to-one product development
Worked in a founding or early-stage startup environment
Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AI

What You’ll Do

In one sentence: build the team that deploys intelligence into the real world — and deploy it alongside them.

Recruit, develop, and lead an exceptional team of Forward Deployed Engineers
Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems
Personally design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team
Own and guide projects from idea → architecture → shipping → iteration
Set the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and hands-on engineering
Translate insights from customer deployments into foundational platform improvements
Partner with other FDE leads to shape standards, playbooks, and how the function scales globally
Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

Our Tech Stack

We choose tools that empower both humans and AI:

Frontend: React, TypeScript
Backend: Golang & Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers
Tooling: GitHub Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more
Always evolving with what works best

How We Hire

Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team
A technical leadership interview — how you build teams, set standards, and make technical decisions
Show us how you approach hard technical problems
Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud
Conversations with the leaders you’d work most closely with, followed by a final discussion

About Your Application

Please submit your application in English — it’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
We treat all candidates equally — if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Software Engineer Opportunity
The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.
You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.
About You
Reliable builder:
You design for failure and prove that recovery works.
Hands-on engineer:
You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.
Strong owner:
You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.
What you will be doing
Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications.
Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries.
Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials.
Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls.
Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery.
Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes.
Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production.
Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect.

What you will bring to the role
Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language.
Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases.
Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures.
Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.
Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems.

Senior:
Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.
Staff:
Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.
Principal:
Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services.
Our stack
Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.
OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open.
And extra credit for
ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering.
Multi-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development.
Deploying agent frameworks, including Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, Strands Agents, Deep Agents or LangGraph. Prior identity experience is optional.

About the Role

Altura is looking for a hands-on Senior AI & Data Platform Engineer to develop the data and conversational AI components of an existing enterprise SaaS analytics platform.

You will take ownership of the BigQuery analytical layer, governed data APIs, and a production-ready AI analytics agent, collaborating directly with our technical leadership and another senior engineer.

Responsibilities

Review and extend existing BigQuery Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
Implement multi-tenant Row-Level Security and PII masking.
Define governed semantic metrics and typed analytical APIs.
Reconcile business KPIs against existing Power BI reporting.
Build an AI analytics agent using Vertex AI or equivalent.
Implement function calling, Pydantic / JSON Schema, and structured JSON outputs.
Manage AI sessions with Redis and secure tenant isolation.
Integrate forecasting services and analytical APIs.
Create automated evaluations, integration tests, and technical documentation.
Ensure the LLM cannot generate or execute SQL directly.

Requirements

5+ years of experience in Python, backend, and data engineering.
Strong BigQuery, SQL, and Google Cloud Platform skills.
Proven experience implementing LLM agents in production.
Experience with function calling, Redis, APIs, and Pydantic.
Familiarity with semantic layers, dimensional modeling, and dbt/Dataform.
Understanding of SaaS security, access controls, and data governance.
Professional English communication skills.
Ability to work independently and meet agreed technical milestones.

Contract Terms

Duration: 12 weeks.
Total compensation: USD 3,000.
Payment schedule: 20% / 30% / 30% / 20%, upon accepted milestones.
Remote and flexible schedule, with agreed coordination meetings.
Complete source code, automated tests, documentation, and handover required.
Contract scope and technical acceptance criteria agreed before the start.

How to Apply

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, relevant production projects, weekly availability, and a short description of your experience with BigQuery, GCP, and AI agents.

Company description

Altura is an AI technology partner for companies that want technology to work inside their operation, not alongside it.

We start by understanding the business. Before proposing anything, we map how the company actually runs: its processes, its systems, its data, and where the operational load sits. The goal is to find where technology has real leverage, and where it doesn't.

We build the roadmap. Opportunities are prioritized by return, effort and dependencies, each one with defined scope, estimated investment, and the indicator it is meant to move. The company ends up knowing what to do first, what it costs, and how success will be measured.

We implement. Custom software when existing tools don't cover what the operation needs. Automations that connect systems and remove manual work. AI agents that analyze information, decide and execute tasks within a process. And the infrastructure that makes all of it run reliably. We are not tied to a predefined solution — we choose the technology each business priority calls for.

We stay after go-live. Solutions reach production and keep being improved. As the operation evolves, we identify what comes next.

One team, from strategy through implementation and beyond. That is the whole point: technology projects usually break at the handoff, so we don't hand off.

Role :- Principal AI Platform Architect (GCP GKE | TPU/GPU Infrastructure)

Location :- Milpitas, CA(Onsite 5 days)

Type: Contract on W2

Position Summary

Customer is seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Principal AI Platform Architect
to lead the design and implementation of a next-generation AI infrastructure platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in architecting and deploying Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters supporting both TPU and GPU workloads
for large-scale AI and Machine Learning applications.
This role requires a technical leader who can directly engage with engineering teams, drive architecture discussions, define platform standards, and establish a scalable, secure, and observable AI platform capable of supporting model development, training, experimentation, and production operations.
The successful candidate will have proven experience designing and implementing TPU-enabled clusters for large-scale model training while optimizing resource utilization, performance, cost, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

AI Platform Architecture & Design

Design and implement enterprise-scale AI platforms on Google Cloud Platform.
Architect highly available and scalable GKE environments supporting:
TPU workloads for AI model training
GPU workloads for inference and accelerated computing
Multi-tenant engineering teams
Define architecture patterns for AI/ML platform lifecycle management.
Establish best practices for workload scheduling, resource isolation, cluster autoscaling, and infrastructure optimization.
Drive platform design reviews and technical governance.

GKE, TPU & GPU Infrastructure

Design and deploy production-grade GKE clusters optimized for AI workloads.
Implement TPU-enabled GKE architectures for large-scale model training.
Configure GPU node pools supporting frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, and distributed training environments.
Design workload placement strategies across TPU and GPU resources.
Optimize cluster performance, utilization, availability, and cost efficiency.
Develop infrastructure blueprints and reference architectures for AI platforms.

AI Platform Operations & Engineering

Define operational models for AI infrastructure management.
Implement cluster lifecycle management, upgrades, patching, and maintenance strategies.
Design automated provisioning and deployment processes using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Establish platform automation using CI/CD and GitOps methodologies.
Develop operational standards for capacity planning and infrastructure scaling.

Resource Allocation & Optimization

Design mechanisms for:
Resource allocation
Quota management
Workload scheduling
Chargeback/showback models
Implement intelligent resource utilization and optimization strategies.
Establish cost governance and monitoring frameworks for TPU/GPU consumption.
Improve utilization efficiency across shared AI compute environments.

Observability & Monitoring

Define and implement platform observability frameworks.
Establish:
Monitoring
Logging
Tracing
Performance analytics
Build operational dashboards for TPU, GPU, and cluster health monitoring.
Create alerting and incident management processes for critical AI workloads.

Security & Compliance

Design security controls aligned to enterprise cloud security standards.
Implement:
Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Workload Identity
Network segmentation
Secret management
Encryption controls
Establish secure multi-tenant AI environments.
Support compliance and governance requirements for AI workloads.

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate directly with Customer engineering leadership and AI teams.
Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions.
Translate business and engineering requirements into scalable platform solutions.
Mentor engineering teams on GCP AI infrastructure best practices.
Act as the primary SME for AI platform architecture and implementation.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
12+ years of IT infrastructure, cloud architecture, or platform engineering experience.
5+ years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Strong experience designing and implementing production-scale GKE environments.
Proven experience deploying TPU-enabled infrastructure for AI model training.
Strong expertise in GPU-based workload orchestration and optimization.
Experience supporting large-scale AI/ML platforms in production environments.
Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture and operations.
Experience with distributed training and high-performance computing environments.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Kirkland, WA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

PhD degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Dissertation research in natural language processing, machine learning, computer vision, speech processing or other relevant area
4 years of experience with research agendas across multiple teams or projects.
One or more first-author publications on topics related to algorithms or data in conferences, journals, or public repositories (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP).

Preferred qualifications:

Expertise in algorithms and the results of ML engineer agents
Track record of execution and impact in a fast-paced research or engineering environment

About The Job

As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Design new data, environments, and learning algorithms for training and evaluating Gemini models
Perform controlled experiments and communicate results
Collaborate with others to land proven improvements for Gemini
Deliver on large portions of a project by defining the data structure, framework, design, and evaluation metrics for research solution development and implementation. Identify timelines and obtain resources needed.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About Buildkite

Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both - giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

About the Role

Our largest customers run CI/CD at frontier scale. AI is driving their build and test workloads up sharply, and more of these large, established companies want a partner to come in and build alongside them so they can grow and scale even faster.

As one of Buildkite's first Forward Deployed Engineers, you'll take on scoped engagements with strategic customers from design through delivery. Customers pay for an outcome: you work out what they actually need, agree on a clear deliverable, build it as production code, and land it in the platform. It's hands-on engineering with real customer access.
You'll spend time on site with the platform teams behind some of the most demanding CI workloads in the world, in the room with their engineers and executives, and you'll stay accountable until what you built works and is handed off. You'll also shape how it runs (how we scope, value, and hand off work) by actually implementing the first engagements, not by writing the playbook first.

You'll sit in our Revenue org alongside Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers, close to customers and Sales, and work hand in hand with Product and our Engineering team in Australia. The role is based on the US West Coast, with regular travel to customer sites (around 25%).

What You'll Do

Work through the customer's reality and scope engagements before the deal closes: partnering with Solution Architects and TAMs to dig into what stands between a customer and Buildkite, identifying true gaps. Spot patterns across customers and bring them back to Product so recurring workarounds become roadmap items.
Turn true gaps into defined engagements: a clear deliverable, an estimate, and exit criteria that the customer and Buildkite both sign off on, then keep the work inside that scope as new asks come up.
Build core platform features, held to the same bar (and using the same frontier tools) as our product engineers. Then hand off cleanly to Product and Engineering so what you build becomes a supported part of Buildkite, benefitting all customers.
Help Solutions Architects and Account Executives recognize FDE opportunities in their deals and explain what FDE is (and isn't) in plain terms, especially as we build the role together through iteration on engagements.

This Is You If..
.
You've shipped production software end to end in the last few years: code you owned and were accountable for, not just contributed to.
You'd pass the same technical bar as our product engineers.
You can translate a business need into a technical spec and back again, and you stay composed when a customer's executive is frustrated.
You're at ease with large, established enterprises: structured evaluations, security reviews, and leaders who want to understand the why before they commit.
You can scope: take a vague ask, craft it into something defined and shippable, be clear about scope, and balance that line when new asks show up mid-engagement.
You'd rather solve the customer's problem than either selling them more or building something shiny.
You have product judgment: you can tell a one-off from something every customer needs.
You want to build and stay close to customers, and you don't want to give up either.
You're excited to help build a new function, and you know that means running the first engagements yourself and letting what you learn shape the playbook.

This Probably Isn't You If...

You want to focus on code with little customer time, or on customers with little code. This role is both.
You prefer a well-defined roadmap to working out what the problem is and taking initiative.
You're looking for hourly consulting, training, or migration work. Those matter, but they're a different role.
You'd rather not travel. Time on site with customers is a core part of this job.

Bonus Points If...

You've led or supported a migration from another CI/CD system.
You've been an early engineer at a developer tools, infrastructure, or B2B SaaS company, or worked in a forward deployed role.
You've worked inside, or alongside, the engineering org of a growth-oriented SaaS company or large enterprise.
You already use Buildkite.

Benefits

20 days paid annual leave plus 10 days sick & carer's leave
— actively encouraged, we want you to be at your best and time off is a part of that.
An ongoing remote-work allowance to help you do your best work
— we want you to have everything you need, from great wifi to wellness options that are right for you.
Retirement and health coverage (based on your region)
— build towards your future, your way.
16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers (6 weeks for secondary)
— becoming a parent is life changing and we're committed to supporting you and your family through it.
Confidential EAP & mental health support
— sometimes life gets hard. You should be able to access the resources and support you need.
Support for learning and growth
— with time and budget for conferences, courses, and coaching so you have the opportunity to grow, improve your craft, and build mastery.
Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world for up to 6 weeks a year
— great work doesn't have to happen from one desk.

Exact benefits may vary slightly by country. We'll walk through the specifics for your location.

Compensation

This role sits on our engineering compensation bands: base salary plus equity. There's no commission: you're measured on outcomes delivered, not on what the customer spends. The base salary range is $223,000 - $247,000 USD. Compensation is determined based on geographic location, relevant experience, and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity

At Buildkite, we value diversity and celebrate all types of skills, backgrounds, and experiences. We're dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment and providing reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process. If you need any accommodations or support during the application or interview process, please reach out to us at: accommodations@buildkite.com.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Our client is seeking a senior, client-facing growth leader to own the AI Engineering workstream across a portfolio of strategic accounts.

The role focuses on building C-suite relationships, originating enterprise transformation opportunities, and converting them into scaled, multi-year programs spanning AI, data, cloud, and engineering modernization.

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of strategic account growth, technology advisory, and transformation execution. They will work closely with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, business executives, and senior technology leaders to understand enterprise priorities and translate them into differentiated AI engineering and modernization strategies.

The role covers the full opportunity lifecycle, from executive engagement and problem definition through solution development, commercial negotiations, deal closure, mobilization, and expansion.

The ultimate objective is to move beyond isolated pilots and establish funded transformation roadmaps, strong executive sponsorship, and repeatable enterprise-wide programs with measurable business and technology outcomes.

Requirements

Experience and Commercial Leadership

15+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital engineering, data and AI services, or enterprise transformation, including significant responsibility for strategic account growth.
Proven track record of originating, shaping, and winning complex, multi-million-dollar or multi-year transformation programs with enterprise clients.
Established credibility with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and senior business executives.
Strong commercial expertise in opportunity qualification, deal strategy, pricing, contracting, negotiation, risk management, and portfolio economics.
Experience leading multidisciplinary, geographically distributed teams in a matrixed organization.

Enterprise Technology and AI Expertise

Strong understanding of enterprise modernization, including:
Cloud-native architecture and data platforms, including Lakehouse patterns
APIs, integration, and microservices
DevSecOps and platform engineering
MLOps/LLMOps and observability
Legacy technology transformation

Working knowledge of applied AI, Generative AI, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model and data engineering, and AI governance.
Understanding of the requirements for secure, reliable, production-scale AI deployment.
Ability to connect technology architecture and engineering decisions with business outcomes, operating-model changes, adoption, and quantified value.

Executive and Client Leadership

Excellent executive communication, storytelling, facilitation, and proposal-writing skills.
Ability to simplify complex technology decisions for both business and technical audiences.
Strong judgment and the ability to challenge clients constructively while building consensus.
Willingness to travel to client locations as required.

Preferred industry experience:
Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), retail, or another data-intensive enterprise sector.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic account entrepreneurship: Identifies growth opportunities, creates momentum, and takes end-to-end ownership.
C-suite influence: Builds trust through relevant insights, candor, and consistent follow-through.
Transformation thinking: Connects business strategy, technology modernization, operating-model change, and measurable value.
Technical credibility: Guides architecture and engineering decisions while maintaining an executive-level perspective.
Commercial discipline: Qualifies opportunities rigorously, builds credible business cases, and protects profitability.
Enterprise orchestration: Aligns client, internal, and partner stakeholders around shared outcomes.
Scale mindset: Designs for adoption, reuse, governance, and repeatability.
Judgment and integrity: Identifies risks early and prioritizes responsible decisions and long-term client trust.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Growth and C-Suite Engagement:
Own the AI Engineering growth agenda, including qualified pipeline, bookings, revenue, margins, and profitable expansion across assigned strategic accounts.
Build trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Chief Digital Officers, business presidents, and senior technology leaders across multiple buying centers.
Develop executive-level perspectives on AI-led transformation and enterprise modernization, linking technology decisions to business growth, productivity, resilience, speed, and customer experience.
Map account priorities, stakeholders, budgets, decision-making processes, and competitive positioning to develop targeted account and pursuit strategies.
Lead executive briefings, innovation sessions, modernization assessments, and co-creation workshops to generate sponsored, outcome-driven transformation opportunities.
Transformation Origination and Enterprise Modernization
Identify and shape strategic opportunities across:
Data platform and cloud modernization
AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, and agentic AI
Application and software engineering
Intelligent operations and enterprise automation
Translate enterprise technology environments and business objectives into multi-year transformation roadmaps, investment cases, target architectures, and governance models.
Connect legacy data, application, integration, and engineering modernization with AI readiness and near-term business value.
Advise clients on responsible AI, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, interoperability, and operating-model requirements for enterprise adoption.
Combine Fractal's capabilities, platforms, accelerators, and industry solutions into integrated transformation propositions rather than standalone offerings.
Pursuit Leadership and Program Scaling
Lead complex, large-scale pursuits from qualification through solution design, value engineering, proposals, commercial negotiations, and executive deal closure.
Develop business cases with defined baseline metrics, expected benefits, investment requirements, risks, dependencies, and a clear path from proof of value to production-scale implementation.
Coordinate consulting, AI, data, cloud, product, design, and engineering teams around a unified client proposition and delivery model.
Remain involved during mobilization and critical delivery milestones to protect the original business case, maintain executive confidence, and identify expansion opportunities.
Scale successful pilots into reusable platforms and multi-business, multi-region programs.
Develop client references and executive advocacy to support further growth across the account portfolio.
Ecosystem and Practice Leadership
Develop joint propositions and go-to-market initiatives with hyperscalers, data and AI platforms, and strategic technology partners.
Create reusable modernization strategies, reference architectures, executive presentations, solution blueprints, estimation models, and pursuit materials to improve win rates and execution speed.
Share market insights and client requirements with capability leaders to influence Fractal's AI Engineering offerings, investments, partnerships, and talent priorities.
Coach account, solution, and engineering leaders, promoting commercial accountability, technical credibility, collaboration, and strong client relationships.

Compensation And Benefits

Benefits include:

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance and disability coverage
Eligibility for the 401(k) plan after 30 days of employment
11 paid holidays
12 weeks of parental leave
Flexible paid time off under the company's free-time PTO policy
Benefits eligibility and terms are governed by the applicable company plans and policies.

About The Company

Our client is a global enterprise AI company specializing in artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, data engineering, and AI-powered solutions for large enterprises, including Fortune 500 companies. By combining deep technical and industry expertise with engineering and design capabilities, the company helps organizations transform critical business functions, modernize technology infrastructure, and scale AI solutions from experimentation to production. Its solutions span industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, consumer goods, technology, and manufacturing, with a focus on improving enterprise decision-making, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business growth.

new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Description

As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities

Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. Feed field learnings back to AWS service teams, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron. Identify opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer engagement.

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Team

The Custom Model and Optimization team, part of the Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with enterprises, AI-native startups, and foundation model providers to build, customize, and optimize generative AI models at scale. Our work spans domain foundation models, post-training of open-weight models, and moving training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. As embedded engineers within the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering motion, we bring deep model and optimization expertise to customers' most strategic AI workloads, and we turn what we learn into tooling and patterns that scale across AWS.

10047

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Experience programming with at least one software programming language
Hands-on experience with generative AI technology, such as LLMs, vision-language models, or speech models

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with large-scale distributed training of LLMs on multi-node accelerator clusters, using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, TorchTitan, Megatron-LM/Megatron Core, NeMo, DeepSpeed, or NeuronX Distributed
Experience with LLM post-training, including SFT, DPO, RLHF, and RL with verifiable rewards or multi-turn agentic RL, using frameworks such as Miles, slime, verl, NeMo-RL, OpenRLHF, SkyRL, or TRL
Experience optimizing model training or inference for latency, throughput, or cost, using serving engines such as SGLang, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM, on AWS Trainium or Inferentia (Neuron SDK), on AWS services such as SageMaker AI, SageMaker HyperPod, or EKS, or by writing custom kernels (CUDA, Triton, NKI)
Experience deploying and operating ML models in customer production environments, working with teams that build and scale end-to-end production systems

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

We’re searching for a Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

In this role you will

Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

Required Qualifications

Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

Desirable Qualifications

ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

Our commitment to safety

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

new_jobs.description:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Associate, Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Clients, Technology & Innovation (CT&I) organization.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and ship full-stack AI-native systems, including user interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, and foundation model integrations, taking concepts rapidly from MVP to hardened production software
Own the architecture, security, scalability, and resilience of your workstream to ensure mission-critical systems operate seamlessly under live enterprise workloads
Execute within fast-paced two-to-six-week sprint cycles, iteratively refining solutions based on direct user and client feedback while surfacing technical constraints early
Implement robust evaluation disciplines and harness tooling across model workflows, capturing learnings into modular, reusable components for broader team adoption
Actively participate in client working sessions and discovery efforts, communicating technical concepts clearly and presenting working software through live demos and compelling narratives
Pair closely with fellow engineers to elevate engineering standards through disciplined code reviews, automated testing, comprehensive documentation, and shared best practices
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum four years of recent, hands-on experience shipping secure, full-stack production software focused on data, ML, and AI-native applications (proficiency in modern languages such as Python, Go, Rust, or Java)
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university in a STEM field or five years relevant practical experience
Proven track record hardening, scaling, and operating distributed systems within major cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud (GCP)), with hands-on experience in enterprise-grade deployments
Deep technical familiarity with frontier LLMs, modern AI coding harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor), agent frameworks, and integration protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol or tool-use standards)
Demonstrated expertise across the end-to-end model loop, including context engineering, prompt optimization, automated evaluation tooling, and strategic model selection
Entrepreneurial drive and comfort with ambiguity, characterized by strong technical leadership, a bias for shipping, and a history of owning outcomes (early-stage startup or founder experience is a strong plus
Strong stakeholder-facing presence with the ability to translate complex architectures to diverse audiences
A portfolio, GitHub repository, or code walk-through demonstrating shipped work is a plus
Ability to travel domestically as needed

new_jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Seekr is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise AI. As a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the platforms that enable large-scale training, serving, evaluation, and deployment of foundation models and autonomous AI agents.

You will work across distributed systems, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, high-performance inference, and enterprise AI platforms to build secure, scalable, and highly reliable systems capable of serving workloads ranging from edge AI deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, AI platform engineering, and production software development. You will collaborate with research scientists, software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure engineers to define the architecture and technical direction of Seekr’s AI platform.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production AI infrastructure supporting model training, fine-tuning, inference, evaluation, and agentic AI workloads.
Design and operate scalable Kubernetes-based infrastructure supporting GPU-accelerated workloads across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and edge environments.
Architect and optimize high-performance inference platforms capable of serving models ranging from resource-constrained edge deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models, with a focus on latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Build and maintain distributed systems that enable reliable scheduling, orchestration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI workloads.
Develop enterprise platforms supporting autonomous and multi-agent AI systems, including secure tool execution, orchestration, memory, evaluation, governance, and observability.
Design, implement, and automate AI infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering practices.
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI infrastructure technologies, model serving frameworks, hardware accelerators, and cloud-native platforms to improve platform performance, scalability, and reliability.
Collaborate with engineering, research, product, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready AI platforms.
Lead technical design discussions, perform architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and establish engineering standards and best practices across the AI Infrastructure organization.
Participate in production support activities, including troubleshooting complex distributed systems, performance tuning, incident response, and continuous operational improvement.

Skills and Qualifications

5–8 years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale platform services
Strong production ML infra experience, executes complex work independently, owns significant components
4 year or higher degree or additional relevant experience, in addition to years of work experience
Demonstrated success designing and operating production Kubernetes environments supporting cloud-native applications and distributed services.
Strong software engineering skills using Python and one or more modern programming languages such as Go, Rust, or C++.
Proven ability to design, build, and operate production AI or machine learning infrastructure.
Expertise developing and optimizing large-scale AI inference platforms, including GPU utilization, distributed inference, batching, caching, quantization, and accelerator performance.
Familiarity with modern AI serving technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of distributed computing, networking, storage systems, cloud-native architectures, and infrastructure automation using technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
Experience developing enterprise AI platforms, autonomous agents, or multi-agent systems, including orchestration, tool execution, governance, observability, and evaluation.
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed messaging systems, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Demonstrated technical leadership, including driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading complex technical initiatives across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, profile, and optimize AI systems for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost across distributed compute environments.

This range reflects Seekr’s good faith estimate of what it expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Placement within the range depends on a number of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, applicable labor categories under Seekr’s federal government contracts, relevant prior work experience, specific skills, education, and certifications. This role may also be eligible for annual bonus, equity, other other incentive compensation.

The proposed salary range for this position is:: $160,000 USD - $230,000 USD

About the Company:

Seekr is a leader in explainable and trustworthy artificial intelligence designed to power mission-critical decisions in enterprises, government, and regulated industries. SeekrFlow™, our end-to-end AI platform, provides secure, auditable AI solutions tailored to sectors where transparency, accuracy, and compliance are paramount. Available across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments, SeekrFlow reduces bias, strengthens data integrity, and simplifies model oversight so organizations can rely on trusted AI decisions in high-stakes settings that impact society’s most sensitive and vital systems. Trusted by leading enterprises and government agencies, we partner with defense, finance, telecom, and critical infrastructure leaders to enable AI solutions that drive real-world results with unmatched transparency and control. We are a team of strategic thinkers and problem-solvers tackling the toughest challenges facing critical infrastructure and global enterprises through best-in-class AI models and customer deployment. Our team operates with unwavering commitment to our core values and mission:

We are driven by outcomes—our customers' success is what we strive for every day.
We believe trust is earned, which is why we build explainability and transparency into the entire AI lifecycle.
We take our responsibility to deliver secure AI seriously.
We believe innovation drives progress—we are building the technologies that power the systems our society depends on.

Company Benefits:

Meaningful Mission & Impact
- Work with a deeply talented, collaborative team solving some of the toughest AI challenges that matter.
Equity Ownership – RSUs that let you share directly in Seekr’s long‑term success and growth.
Time Off That Respects Real Life
– Unlimited PTO plus 14 paid company holidays to truly recharge.
Work Your Way – A flexible hybrid work environment with offices in Reston, VA and Austin, TX.
Competitive Total Rewards – A role‑appropriate compensation structure that supports long‑term growth, including base salary, bonuses, or commission plans depending on role.
401(k) with Company Match
– Build your future with a retirement plan that includes employer matching.
Comprehensive Health & Wellness
– Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage starting day one—for you and your family.
Parental Leave – Paid parental leave to support employees as they welcome a new child through birth, adoption, or foster placement.

Important Notice:

To conform to U.S. Government international trade regulations, applicant must be a U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.

new_jobs.title: Software Architect, AI Systems and Platform
new_jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Software Architect Opportunity
The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.
We are hiring two hands-on architects. One will lead agent execution, harnesses and evaluations. The other will lead backend services, integrations, data and platform reliability. You will write critical code, resolve cross-team decisions and work with engineers through production rollout.
About You
Hands-on builder:
You still write production code and test important decisions through implementation.
Practical architect:
You choose a small, clear design and make it easy to extend when the product grows.
Trusted partner:
You earn confidence through useful code, clear feedback and customer understanding.
What you will be doing
Define and implement shared contracts for tasks, events, permissions, approvals, evidence and usage.
Set clear boundaries between model reasoning, agent harnesses, durable workflows and services that enforce authorization.
Select a harness through representative identity tasks, failure tests and operational evidence. Keep model providers and harness components replaceable.
Design integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, including data boundaries, latency, cost, version changes and measured release quality.
Build reference services for tenant isolation, scoped tool execution, idempotency, long approval waits and verified results.
Define the transactional and analytics data architecture. Keep PostgreSQL application state separate from the planned ClickHouse or BigQuery analytics layer.
Connect Product, Applied AI and Platform engineers through clear ownership and practical APIs. Resolve dependencies that slow delivery.
Write critical implementations, review recovery and security, and guide technical leads through production rollout and customer expansion.

What you will bring to the role
A record of leading architecture and delivery across multiple engineering teams, with recent production code you personally implemented.
Deep knowledge of distributed services, API design, data consistency, cloud security and production operations.
Experience making systems simpler while improving reliability, security or delivery speed.
The ability to explain design tradeoffs, guide senior engineers and remain accountable through implementation.
Depth in at least one of the two role areas below, plus the ability to work across the full product.

Role focus
AI systems architect:
Build and evaluate agent harnesses, context management, model integrations and quality controls. Relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a comparable custom runtime.
Platform architect:
Lead backend, connector, security, data and workflow architecture. Bring deep production systems experience and practical knowledge of integrating model-driven workflows.
Our stack
Python FastAPI, React and TypeScript, AWS Amplify, Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge and API Gateway. Storage uses RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector and S3. Security and operations include KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail.
We are adding OpenAI and Anthropic model API integrations. An agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery are planned. You will help choose and implement them.
And extra credit for
Enterprise identity, security products, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or complex customer integrations.
ClickHouse, BigQuery, agent evaluations, post-training systems or open-source infrastructure.
Building a new product within a larger enterprise and keeping technical decisions reversible.

new_jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Scientist V

Location: Onsite at Menlo Park, CA (Hybrid)

Duration: 6 months initially on W2 with extension up to 30 Months

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with 10+ years of industry experience to join our team. The successful candidate will have a strong background in data analysis, statistical modelling, and data visualization, as well as excellent communication skills.

Minimum Years of Experience

10+

Key Projects/Day-to-Day Responsibilities:

Perform EDA to identify trends and generate deep-level insights
Define business OKRs and success metrics with stakeholders
Build dashboards and visualizations for clear narrative understanding
Present data findings and recommendations to mixed audiences
Develop predictive models and conduct research/experimentation

Must-Have Skills

Data Analysis & SQL — Strong EDA skills with advanced SQL proficiency
Setting Goals & Success Metrics — Ability to collaborate with stakeholders on defining OKRs and measuring progress
10+ years of quantitative/analytical experience — Using scripting languages (Python), statistical tools, and data querying at scale

Nice-to-Have Skills

Visualization — Designing dashboards and high-performance reports
Storytelling Through Data — Communicating insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Predictive/Forecasting Modeling — Regression, clustering, classification techniques

Key Responsibilities:

Data Analysis: Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and correlations; apply statistical and quantitative tools or techniques; interpret data and formulate deep-level insights.
Setting Goals and Success Metrics: Collaborate with stakeholders to define business objectives and key results (OKRs); define success metrics that measure short and long-term progress towards OKRs.
Visualization: Design visualizations that provide a clear narrative understanding as well as deep dive capabilities; develop high-performance reports and dashboards.
Storytelling Through Data: Develop compelling narratives to communicate data insights for technical and non-technical audiences; utilize various relevant tools and techniques to effectively present data; provide recommendations based on analytical findings and insights, with prioritization of actions and estimated impact.
Modeling: Develop and implement predictive and forecasting models using multiple techniques such as regression, clustering, classification, and more; evaluate and refine models based on performance metrics; generate actionable insights from model output.
Research and Experiment: Formulate multiple hypotheses that are tied together to answer business questions; develop a comprehensive research plan that identifies appropriate data collection tools, techniques, or methods to be used for a specific
research problem; conduct research with appropriate methods to answer the research questions or test hypotheses.

Requirements:

10+ years of industry experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches, including defining metrics and goals, monitoring key metrics, understanding root causes of changes in metrics, and exploratory analysis to Client new opportunities.
10+ years of industry experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python), and/or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R).
Strong background in data analysis, statistical modeling, and data visualization.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

is actively seeking a Software Engineer III with a focus on AI and Machine Learning (ML)
to support a contract developing an AI tool to automate the comparison process for U.S. Navy engineering drawings or “Damage Control Plates” in Virginia Beach, VA
. The software engineer will be part of a team building a computer vision-based image processing pipeline that ingests two versions of the DC plates and identifies differences, and a locally deployed language model that takes output from the first component and generates draft comparison reports.

Implement drawing ingestion and normalization routines supporting multiple file formats including PDF, TIFF, CGM, DXF, and JPEG.
Ensure all software components are deployable on existing on-premise hardware with no cloud infrastructure dependency.

new_jobs.description:
United Risk is a global property and casualty insurance underwriting and distribution platform. It is independently owned and operated by its practice partners and affiliated with Applied Underwriters. Our practices cover specialty casualty and property, surety, financial lines, aviation, crisis and political risk, marine, fine art and more. Each one is led by underwriters who run their specialty with real autonomy.

Our AI team builds the tools that make those underwriters quicker and smarter. That includes submission ingestion, underwriting workbenches, risk analysis, and automation across the back and middle office. Our focus is to deliver tailored solutions to improve efficiency, while also maintaining our standards to security and compliance.

The Role:

You'll be one of a small group of AI Engineers. You'll work directly with underwriters and operations staff. You'll adapt the products we already run to their needs, and build new ones where nothing fits.

This role leans toward data science: turning our submission, policy and loss data into insight underwriters can act on. Everyone on the team also builds applications and works on infrastructure. Three senior AI engineers review your work and teach you along the way.

Requirements:

A bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or a related field
0–4 years of experience, including internships and co-ops
Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with messy real-world data
A grounding in statistics
Work you built yourself and can show us. For this role, that means one or more of:
A structured-extraction or document-processing project
A RAG or document Q&A system
An evaluation or testing setup for model or LLM output
A data analysis or modeling project on a real dataset

Curiosity about how the business runs, and the patience to learn insurance from the people who know it
Clear communication with non-technical colleagues

Our Benefits Include:

100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees
401(k) plan with 100% immediate vesting and a 4% company match
Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays.
Life, disability, critical illness and accident insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Pre-tax Flexible Spending Accounts for health, dependent care, and commuter-related expenses
Tuition reimbursement
Fitness reimbursement and various additional quality-of-life benefits

Apply through this posting with your résumé and a link to your GitHub, a deployed app or a portfolio. We review portfolios first. If you're shortlisted, you'll walk one of our senior engineers through a project you built and the choices you made.

United Risk is independently owned and operated by its practice partners and is affiliated with Applied Underwriters through its common and powerful brand identity.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Platform & Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Software Engineer Opportunity
The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.
You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.
About You
Reliable builder:
You design for failure and prove that recovery works.
Hands-on engineer:
You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.
Strong owner:
You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.
What you will be doing
Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications.
Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries.
Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials.
Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls.
Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery.
Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes.
Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production.
Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect.

What you will bring to the role
Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language.
Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases.
Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures.
Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.
Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems.

Scope by level
Senior:
Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.
Staff:
Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.
Principal:
Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services.
Our stack
Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.
OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open.
And extra credit for
ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering.
Multi-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development.
Deploying agent frameworks, including Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, Strands Agents, Deep Agents or LangGraph. Prior identity experience is optional.
